title: Messages to the Kings of Judah

questions.question: Thus says the Lord: "Go down to the house of the... and speak there this word,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:1 (ESV): "Go down to the house of the king of Judah and speak there this word,"

questions.question: "Thus says the Lord: Do justice and righteousness, and deliver from the hand of the oppressor him who has been robbed. And do no wrong or violence to the... , the fatherless, and the widow,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:3 (ESV): "And do no wrong or violence to the resident alien, the fatherless, and the widow, nor shed innocent blood in this place."

questions.question: "But if you will not hear these words, I swear by... , declares the Lord, that this house shall become a desolation."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:5 (ESV): "I swear by myself, declares the Lord, that this house shall become a desolation."

questions.question: "I will prepare destroyers against you, each with his... ; and they shall cut down your choicest cedars and cast them into the fire."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:7 (ESV): "I will prepare destroyers against you, each with his weapons; and they shall cut down your choicest cedars and cast them into the fire."

questions.question: "And many nations will pass by this city, and every man will say to his neighbor, 'Why has the Lord dealt thus with this great city?' And they will answer, 'Because they have forsaken the... of the Lord their God and worshiped other gods and served them.'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:8-9 (ESV): "Because they have forsaken the covenant of the Lord their God and worshiped other gods and served them."

questions.question: Regarding Shallum (Jehoahaz), the Lord says he will return no more to the land, but he shall die in the place where they have exiled him. Who was he the son of?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:11 (ESV): "For thus says the Lord concerning Shallum the son of Josiah, king of Judah,"

questions.question: "Woe to him who builds his house by unrighteousness, and his upper rooms by injustice, who makes his neighbor serve him for..., and does not give him his wages,"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:13 (ESV): "who makes his neighbor serve him for nothing, and does not give him his wages,"

questions.question: Who did the Lord say built a house of cedar, painting it vermilion, but his father Josiah did justice and righteousness, so it was well with him?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:14-15, 18 (ESV): The prophecy is directed at Jehoiakim... "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah:"

questions.question: What did the Lord say would be the burial of Jehoiakim?
options: With the burial of a donkey
Cast into the valley of Hinnom
questions.correctAnswer: With the burial of a donkey
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:19 (ESV): "With the burial of a donkey he shall be buried, dragged and dumped beyond the gates of Jerusalem."

questions.question: "Go up to Lebanon, and cry out, and lift up your voice in Bashan; cry out from... , for all your lovers are destroyed."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:20 (ESV): "cry out from Abarim, for all your lovers are destroyed."

questions.question: "I spoke to you in your prosperity, but you said, 'I will not listen.' This has been your way from your..., that you have not obeyed my voice."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:21 (ESV): "This has been your way from your youth, that you have not obeyed my voice."

questions.question: Regarding Coniah (Jehoiachin) the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, the Lord says: "though Coniah... were the signet... on my right hand, yet I would tear you off"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:24 (ESV): "though Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, were the signet ring on my right hand, yet I would tear you off"

questions.question: "I will give you into the hand of those who seek your life, into the hand of those of whom you are afraid, even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of the..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:25 (ESV): "even into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon and into the hand of the Chaldeans."

questions.question: "Is this man Coniah a despised, broken pot, a vessel no one cares for? Why are he and his children hurled and cast into a land that they do not know? O land, land, land, hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord: 'Write this man down as...'"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:28-30 (ESV): "Thus says the Lord: 'Write this man down as childless, a man who shall not succeed in his days,'"

questions.question: Why was Coniah to be written down as childless?
options: For none of his offspring shall succeed in sitting on the throne of David
Because his children were killed in the siege
Because he would be given as a eunuch in Babylon
Because the Lord cut off his line permanently from the earth
questions.correctAnswer: For none of his offspring shall succeed in sitting on the throne of David
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 22:30 (ESV): "for none of his offspring shall succeed in sitting on the throne of David and ruling again in Judah."

key_verse_text: "He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then it was well. Is not this to know me? declares the Lord."
